decisions.decision: Training will focus on enabling developers to use AI tools effectively (read/run apps, use real data contracts, direct and review AI output) rather than making them framework experts.
decisions.evidence: We're not trying them to build them as an expert. The moment they go, they know how to go on to Claude and ask them

decisions.decision: Skill-gap assessment (via poll) will be done first to identify who actually needs HTML/CSS/JavaScript training before committing to an organization-wide training plan.
decisions.evidence: Or, if you can put a poll in one of these, let's see here.

threads.note: Debate on whether to standardize training on React vs staying framework-agnostic; leaning React for documentation and popularity, not exclusivity.
threads.evidence: if rules are better option, OK, or any other framework, because operating framework can be anything
